item.title: How to Book a Lab Appointment in British Columbia (And What to Know Before You Go)

item.description: A plain-language tour of the hospital technology stack: EHRs like Epic and Oracle Health, revenue cycle, scheduling, patient flow, LIS, PACS and integration.
